definitions.explanation: The act of throwing away or abandoning something, especially waste or unwanted items, often illegally. Most commonly used in the context of illegal dumping of garbage or hazardous materials.

examples.japanese: ゴミの{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}は{犯罪|はんざい}だ。
examples.english: Illegal dumping of garbage is a crime.

examples.japanese: {産業廃棄物|さんぎょ���はいきぶつ}の{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Illegal dumping of industrial waste has become a problem.

examples.japanese: {海洋|かいよう}への{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}{投棄|とうき}は{国際条約|こくさいじょうやく}で{厳|きび}しく{規制|きせい}されている。
examples.english: Dumping waste into the ocean is strictly regulated by international treaties.

notes:
Composed of {投|とう} (throw) + {棄|き} (discard/abandon). Almost always used in a negative context — illegal, irresponsible, or environmentally harmful disposal of waste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不法投棄|ふほうとうき}: illegal dumping (the most common usage)
- {廃棄物|はいきぶつ}の{投棄|とうき}: dumping of waste
- {海洋投棄|かいようとうき}: ocean dumping
- {投棄|とうき}する: to dump; to dispose of illegally
- {投棄|とう��}{禁止|きんし}: dumping prohibited

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {廃棄|はいき}: disposal, scrapping — more neutral; refers to proper disposal or scrapping of items
- {処分|しょぶん}: disposal, disposition — broader and more neutral; includes both proper and improper disposal
- {放棄|ほうき}: abandonment, renunciation — giving up rights or claims; less about physical dumping

USAGE:
{不法投棄|ふほうとうき} (illegal dumping) is a major environmental concern in Japan. Signs reading {投棄|とうき}{禁止|きんし} (no dumping) are common in rural areas and along roadsides. Penalties for illegal dumping can include imprisonment and fines.
